problem:

$$
{x}^{′}(t)=Ax(t),\,x(0)=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$

given that the general solution to our differential equation is

$$
x(t)={c}_{1}[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2\end{aligned}]{e}^{t}+{c}_{2}[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1\end{aligned}]{e}^{-t},\,{c}_{1},{c}_{2}\in R.
$$

The solution to the initial value problem is
